sculpt_ground_quarry_face_a.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_ground_quarry_face_a.notes: Facet stone (quarry_face_a) for the landmark rock set pieces: exact planes with bevelled edges, beds / joints / drill marks as geometry, moss cushion as its own primitive (Moss_none). Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, neutral stone ~#9b9b9b). LOD tris 706 / 376 / 117. Origin = foot centre, ~1 m unit; src/world/landforms/setpieces.js fits it into each piece's box.
